# PLLM

Release: 0.1.0
Build: sha256:dab1bcb88380ca9a4c2b79e3de085391f482bb97d841a9f0741979579c87dbfb

- [Benchmark and inspect runs](https://pllm.run/cli/benchmarking/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/cli/benchmarking.md)): Run the headless transport benchmark or open the diagnostic dashboard.
- [Command-line interface](https://pllm.run/cli/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/cli.md)): Inspect PLLM records and run local benchmarks from the terminal.
- [Inspect configuration and research](https://pllm.run/cli/inspect-and-research/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/cli/inspect-and-research.md)): Validate public experiment data and inspect built-in component or research records.
- [Run private inference](https://pllm.run/cli/private-inference/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/cli/private-inference.md)): Run the trusted gateway locally or connect it to independently operated PLLM roles.
- [Operate provider roles](https://pllm.run/cli/provider-roles/) ([Markdown](https://pllm.run/cli/provider-roles.md)): Start authenticated inference and preparation services without exposing application APIs.
